candidates.name: Caroline Shinkle

own_words.text: "Allow New Yorkers to keep more of what they earn by reducing tax on work."
"Champion and support our law enforcement officers and first responders who keep our city safe."
"Unapologetically stand with the Jewish community of New York City and with Israel."

candidates.name: Wilneida Negron
candidates.background: First-time candidate on the "For All of Us" line. Says she has spent 20 years working across government, labor, technology and financial markets, including policy on AI, wage theft and privacy.

own_words.text: "People-powered. Independent. Running for Congress in NY-12."
"No corporate PAC money. No special interests. Just neighbors."
Her plans include putting "people in charge of AI, data, and technology" and lowering household costs.

candidates.name: Karen Ortiz
candidates.background: Attorney and former U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission administrative judge, running on her own independent line. Says she was fired from federal service in 2025 after refusing to follow executive orders she calls anti-trans.

own_words.text: "If I am elected, I vow to introduce Articles of Impeachment on Day One."
"We need Medicare for All to ensure that everyone has access to truly affordable, quality healthcare."
On ICE: "It simply must be dismantled and abolished."
